title: Used to / Would (Past Habits)
summary: إزاي تتكلم عن عادات وحالات قديمة مبقتش موجودة بـ used to و would، وتقارنها بدلوقتي.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: We use **used to** and **would** to talk about things that happened **again and again in the past** but do not happen now. They are useful for describing how a hobby began before it changed into something else.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إزاي تتكلم عن **عادات قديمة**: حاجات كنت بتعملها زمان كتير، ودلوقتي خلاص مبقتش تعملها، أو اتغيرت. في العربي بنقول ببساطة: **«كنت بـ…»** أو **«زمان كنت…»**.

في الكتاب الدرس ده موجود في **Book 2 · Unit 7: Discovering Your Passion**، جزء **Used to / Would (Past Habits)** (صفحة 47)، بعد قصة **Mariam** اللي هوايتها في عمل الكيك اتحولت لشغل. وبييجي تاني في **Consolidation Review D**، وفي الـ **Presentation Task** («I used to…»)، وفي الـ **Writing Task** بتاع الـ proposal اللي لازم يكون فيه **used to أو would** مرة على الأقل.
الفكرة ببساطة: «زمان… ودلوقتي»

text: **used to** = a past habit or state that is **no longer true**. We often contrast it with the **present simple** for now.

blocks.text: تخيل إنك بتحكي عن نفسك: «زمان **كنت بلعب** كورة كل يوم، دلوقتي **بلعب** شطرنج». الجزء الأول ده هو **used to**، والجزء التاني هو **present simple** (عادة دلوقتي).

items.en: She **used to bake** for fun. Now she **bakes** for customers too.
items.ar: زمان كانت بتعمل كيك للمتعة بس، دلوقتي بتعمل للزباين كمان. used to للماضي، وbakes للحاضر.

items.en: I **used to draw** comics every day after school.
items.ar: كنت برسم كوميكس كل يوم بعد المدرسة (ودلوقتي لأ، أو مش بنفس الشكل).

blocks.text: الكتاب بيدّينا كلمتين:

items: **used to + فعل في المصدر** ← للعادات القديمة (habits) **وكمان** للحالات القديمة (states) زي: كان عندي، كنت ساكن، كنت بحب.
**would + فعل في المصدر** ← للأفعال **المتكررة** بس (actions). **مش** للحالات (NOT for states).

blocks.text: القواعد والأشكال

rows: She **used to spend** Fridays baking alone.
كانت بتقضي أيام الجمعة بتخبز لوحدها.
He **didn't use to take** orders from strangers.
ماكانش بياخد طلبات من ناس غريبة. خلي بالك: use **من غير d**.
**Did** you **use to sell** your drawings online?
كنت بتبيع رسوماتك أونلاين؟ برضه use **من غير d**.
She **would pipe** wonky flowers onto cupcakes every weekend.
كانت بترسم ورد معووج على الكب كيك كل ويك إند.
On busy days, he **wouldn't stop** for lunch.
في الأيام المشغولة ماكانش بيقف ياكل. (قليلة الاستخدام)
She **used to bake** for fun. **Now** she **bakes** for customers.

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ: الـ d بتختفي مع did
blocks.text: **did** خدت الـ «d» بتاعة الماضي، فـ **used** ترجع **use**: ✓ didn't **use** to / Did you **use** to …? ✗ didn't **used** to. زي بالظبط: I **played** ← I didn't **play**.
الفرق المهم: Habits (عادات) ولا States (حالات)؟

text: **Habits / actions** are things we do (play, bake, draw, visit). **States** are situations or feelings (be, have, live, like, love, know, believe, own). **used to** works with both. **would** works with actions only.

blocks.text: ده أهم سؤال في الدرس. اسأل نفسك: الفعل ده **حاجة بتتعمل** ولا **حالة** أو إحساس؟

rows: bake, draw, practise, visit, play, repair, walk
be, have (= own), live, like, love, hate, know, believe, own, want

items.en: When I was ten, I **used to be** very shy.
items.ar: حالة (be): كنت خجول جدًا. ✗ I would be very shy.

items.en: Omar **used to have** a small workshop in his bedroom.
items.ar: have هنا بمعنى «يمتلك» (حالة)، فـ would ماتنفعش.

items.en: Every Thursday, Hassan **would arrive** early to prepare the chess boards.
items.ar: فعل متكرر (arrive) ومعاه كلمة وقت (Every Thursday)، فـ would تمام. وused to كمان صح.

items.en: We **used to live** near the old pottery workshop.
items.ar: live حالة، فـ used to بس.

items.en: My grandfather **would tell** us stories about his carpentry work.
items.ar: فعل متكرر (tell): جدي كان بيحكيلنا حكايات.

items.en: Salma **used to love** painting, but she lost interest during exams.
items.ar: love إحساس (state)، فـ used to مش would.

blocks.title: خلي بالك
blocks.text: **would** محتاجة غالبًا **سياق واضح** إننا بنتكلم عن الماضي (When I was young… / Every Friday… / In those days…). علشان كده الحكاية عادة **تبدأ بـ used to** وبعدين نكمّل بـ **would** علشان مانكررش.
used to ولا Past Simple؟

text: Use the **past simple** for one action, or for actions with an exact number of times or a fixed period. Use **used to** for repeated habits that have now stopped.

blocks.text: الـ past simple بيتكلم عن **حاجة حصلت** وخلاص. أما used to فبتركز على إنها كانت **عادة** ومبقتش موجودة:

rows: I **visited** the Khan El-Khalili workshop **last week**.
I **used to visit** the workshop **every summer**.
✗ I **used to visit** the workshop **three times**.
عدد مرات محدد ← قول **visited** three times.

blocks.text: ملحوظة: الـ past simple ينفع **كمان** للعادات القديمة (When I was young, I **played** football every day). بس used to **أوضح** في إنها مبقتش بتحصل دلوقتي.
ماتلخبطش: used to ≠ be used to ≠ get used to

text: **used to + verb** = past habit. **be used to + verb-ing / noun** = be familiar with something (it is normal for you). **get used to + verb-ing / noun** = become familiar with something.

blocks.text: دي من أشهر الفخاخ. الكلمات شبه بعض بس المعنى مختلف تمامًا:

rows: I **am used to working** in a team now.
She **got used to waking** up early for her internship.

items.en: Mariam **used to work** at home. Now she **is used to working** with a large team.
items.ar: زمان كانت بتشتغل في البيت، دلوقتي متعودة على الشغل مع فريق كبير. لاحظ: work في الأول و working في التاني.

items.en: At first, the new volunteers found it hard, but they soon **got used to teaching** younger students.
items.ar: اتعودوا بسرعة على تعليم الطلبة الأصغر.

blocks.title: خلي بالك
blocks.text: ✗ I **am used to work** late. ✓ I **am used to working** late. بعد **be used to** الفعل يبقى **-ing**، لأن to هنا حرف جر.
أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي عن موضوعات Unit 7: الهوايات اللي بتكبر، المجتمع اللي بيتبني حوالين هواية، نقل المهارة لغيرك، والتوازن بين الهواية والمذاكرة.

items.en: Mariam **used to bake** only for her family, but now she **takes** orders every weekend.
items.ar: زمان كانت بتخبز لعيلتها بس، دلوقتي بتاخد طلبات كل ويك إند.

items.en: Omar **used to repair** old radios after school.
items.ar: عمر كان بيصلّح راديوهات قديمة بعد المدرسة.

items.en: He **would open** each radio carefully to see why it had stopped working.
items.ar: كان بيفتح كل راديو بحرص علشان يشوف ليه بطّل يشتغل. فعل متكرر ← would.

items.en: I **didn't use to share** my photos with anyone. Now I post them online every week.
items.ar: ماكنتش بوري حد صوري، دلوقتي بنزلها أونلاين كل أسبوع.

items.en: **Did** your father **use to play** the oud when he was young?
items.ar: باباك كان بيعزف عود وهو صغير؟ Did + use to (من غير d).

items.en: Our chess club **used to have** only five members.
items.ar: النادي كان فيه 5 أعضاء بس. have هنا حالة، فـ used to مش would.

items.en: Every evening, my grandmother **would teach** me how to embroider.
items.ar: كل يوم بالليل جدتي كانت بتعلمني التطريز. نقل مهارة (mentoring).

items.en: Karim **never used to finish** his homework because he spent hours gaming.
items.ar: كريم عمره ماكان بيخلص واجبه علشان كان بيقضي ساعات بيلعب. never used to = didn't use to بس أقوى.

items.en: Students **used to think** that hobbies were a waste of time.
items.ar: الطلبة كانوا فاكرين إن الهوايات تضييع وقت. think هنا بمعنى «يعتقد» (state) ← used to.

items.en: Now Salma **practises** for twenty minutes a day instead of six hours once a month.
items.ar: present simple للعادة الجديدة دلوقتي.

blocks.text: إزاي نستخدمه في الكلام والكتابة

text: In a presentation or a proposal, **used to** shows the situation **before**, and the present simple shows the situation **now**. This makes the change clear to your listener or reader.

blocks.text: في الـ Presentation Task الكتاب بيدّيك جملة «**I used to…**». وفي الـ proposal لازم تستخدم used to أو would. الفكرة إنك **توضح التغيير**: كان إيه الوضع **قبل** وبقى إيه **دلوقتي**. شوف المثال ده:

text: Our school **used to have** no space for students who enjoy fixing things. Broken bicycles and old fans **would end up** in the rubbish, and nobody **would try** to repair them. Now, many students **are** interested in repair skills, so we recommend starting a weekly Repair Club.

blocks.text: لاحظ: **used to have** (حالة: ماكانش عندنا مكان) ← بعدها **would end up / would try** (أفعال متكررة) ← بعدها **are** (دلوقتي) ← وبعدين الـ recommendation.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ When I was ten, I **use to** collect stickers. ← ✓ I **used to** collect stickers. (في الإثبات لازم d)
✗ I **didn't used to** like vegetables. ← ✓ I **didn't use to** like vegetables. (مع did من غير d)
✗ **Did** you **used to** sell online? ← ✓ Did you **use to** sell online?
✗ I would **spending** hours reading comics. ← ✓ I would **spend** hours … (بعد would المصدر)
✗ Mariam would **to decorate** cakes. ← ✓ Mariam would **decorate** cakes. (مفيش to بعد would)
✗ I **would be** shy as a child. ← ✓ I **used to be** shy. (be حالة)
✗ Omar **uses to** repair radios. ← ✓ Omar **used to** repair radios. (مفيش uses to في المضارع)
✗ She **is used to bake** every day now. ← ✓ She **is used to baking** … أو She **bakes** every day now.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: فيه **did / didn't** قبل الفراغ؟ يبقى **use to** من غير d.
الفعل **حالة** (be, have, live, like, know)؟ استبعد **would**.
بعد **would** و**used to** الفعل **مصدر** (bake, spend, decorate).
فيه **now** أو كلام عن دلوقتي؟ استخدم **present simple** للجزء ده.
فيه **am / is / are used to**؟ الفعل بعده **-ing**.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

text: Karim ______ like reading, but now he reads a novel every month.
a. wouldn't  b. didn't use to  c. didn't used to  d. wasn't use to

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b.** ليه؟ like **حالة** (إحساس) فـ wouldn't ماتنفعش. (c) used مع did غلط. (d) wasn't use to مش تركيب صحيح.
**2) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct.**

text: a. Every summer, my uncle would taking me fishing.
b. Every summer, my uncle would take me fishing.
c. Every summer, my uncle would to take me fishing.
d. Every summer, my uncle would took me fishing.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b.** ليه؟ بعد would فعل في **المصدر** من غير to ومن غير -ing ومن غير تصريف تاني.
**3) Read the passage and find the mistakes, then correct them.**

text: As a child, Nadia use to collect old coins. She would has a small box for them.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** use to ← **used to** (إثبات، لازم d). would has ← **used to have** (have هنا ملكية/حالة، وبعد would مايجيش has أصلاً).
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. My grandmother ______ cook pasta. She only made traditional Egyptian dishes.
a. didn't use to  b. don't use to  c. wasn't use to  d. didn't used to
items.a: **a. didn't use to** — نفي: didn't + use to (من غير d) + cook.

items.q:
2. When I was in primary school, I ______ very shy.
a. would be  b. used to be  c. am used to being  d. use to be
items.a: **b. used to be** — be حالة، فـ would ماتنفعش. و(d) ناقصها d.

items.q:
3. Every Friday, my grandfather ______ me to the carpentry workshop.
a. would take  b. would took  c. would taking  d. would to take
items.a: **a. would take** — would + مصدر، وفيه Every Friday (فعل متكرر).

items.q:
4. ______ you use to play an instrument?
a. Were  b. Do  c. Did  d. Have
items.a: **c. Did** — سؤال used to بيبدأ بـ Did.

items.q:
5. Omar used to repair radios for free. Now he ______ money for his repairs.
a. used to charge  b. charges  c. would charge  d. is used to charge
items.a: **b. charges** — Now ← present simple للعادة الحالية.

items.q:
6. Our art club ______ only six members, but now it has thirty.
a. would have  b. used to have  c. use to have  d. was used to have
items.a: **b. used to have** — have = يمتلك (حالة)، فـ would غلط.

items.q:
7. Salma is a nurse now, so she is used to ______ at night.
a. work  b. worked  c. working  d. works
items.a: **c. working** — be used to + -ing = متعودة.

items.q:
8. I ______ the coding club three times last month.
a. used to visit  b. would visit  c. visited  d. use to visit
items.a: **c. visited** — عدد مرات محدد (three times) ← past simple.

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. Hassan use to arrive early at the chess club.
b. Hassan used to arrive early at the chess club.
c. Hassan uses to arrive early at the chess club.
d. Hassan did used to arrive early at the chess club.
items.a: **b** — إثبات: used to + مصدر. (a) ناقصها d، (c) مفيش uses to، (d) did used غلط.

items.q:
10. a. Did Nour used to volunteer at the library?
b. Did Nour use to volunteer at the library?
c. Used Nour to volunteer at the library?
d. Does Nour used to volunteer at the library?
items.a: **b** — Did + use to (من غير d).

items.q:
11. a. As a child, I would know the names of all the football players.
b. As a child, I used to knew the names of all the football players.
c. As a child, I used to know the names of all the football players.
d. As a child, I was used to know the names of all the football players.
items.a: **c** — know حالة ← used to + مصدر (know).

items.q:
12. a. My sister would spending hours sewing dresses for her dolls.
b. My sister would spends hours sewing dresses for her dolls.
c. My sister would to spend hours sewing dresses for her dolls.
d. My sister would spend hours sewing dresses for her dolls.
items.a: **d** — would + مصدر (spend). وsewing هنا عادي لأنه بعد spend hours.

blocks.text: **C. Fill in the gaps with used to, would, or the present simple. Use the verbs in brackets.**

text: When Youssef was twelve, he (13) ______ (spend) every afternoon taking photos of birds with his father's old phone. Every weekend, he (14) ______ (walk) along the Nile to find new birds. He (15) ______ (not / think) that photography could be a career. Now he (16) ______ (sell) his photos to a nature magazine, and he (17) ______ (teach) a photography workshop for children every month.

items.a: **used to spend** — عادة قديمة، وأول جملة في الحكاية فنبدأ بـ used to. (would spend كمان مقبولة لأن فيه سياق When he was twelve.)
**would walk** (أو used to walk) — فعل متكرر (Every weekend) بعد ما الحكاية بدأت.

items.q: 15. he ______ (not / think)
items.a: **didn't use to think** — think هنا بمعنى يعتقد (حالة) ونفي ← didn't use to.
**sells** — Now ← present simple، وhe مفرد فنزود s.
**teaches** — عادة حالية (every month) ← present simple، teach ← teaches.

blocks.text: **D. Find the mistake in each sentence and correct it.**

items.q: 18. When we were children, my brother and I use to fly kites on the roof.
items.a: use to ← **used to**: … my brother and I **used to** fly kites … — في الإثبات لازم d.

items.q: 19. Every winter, my aunt would knitting scarves for the whole family.
items.a: would knitting ← **would knit** — بعد would المصدر.

items.q: 20. We didn't used to have a computer at home.
items.a: didn't used to ← **didn't use to**: We **didn't use to** have a computer at home. — مع did بتتشال الـ d.

items.q: 21. My cousin would live in Alexandria before he moved to Cairo.
items.a: would live ← **used to live** — live حالة، فـ would ماتنفعش.

blocks.text: **E. Rewrite or write as asked.**

items.q: 22. Rewrite using used to: When she was young, Hana played basketball every day, but she doesn't play now.
items.a: Hana **used to play** basketball every day. — used to بتوضح إنها كانت عادة ومبقتش.

items.q: 23. Rewrite in the negative: Ahmed used to enjoy science lessons.
items.a: Ahmed **didn't use to enjoy** science lessons. — didn't + use to (من غير d) + enjoy.

items.q: 24. Write a question with used to about a hobby.
items.a: مثال: **Did** you **use to collect** stamps when you were a child? — Did + فاعل + use to + مصدر.

items.q: 25. Write 3 sentences comparing a hobby in the past and now. Use used to, would and the present simple.
items.a: مثال: I **used to play** video games for hours every night. On school days, I **would go** to bed very late and feel tired the next morning. Now I **play** for only one hour at the weekend and **spend** my free time learning photography. — used to للبداية، would للفعل المتكرر، present simple لدلوقتي.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **used to + مصدر** = عادة أو حالة قديمة ومبقتش. **would + مصدر** = فعل متكرر في الماضي بس، **مش** للحالات (be, have, live, like, know).
النفي: **didn't use to**، والسؤال: **Did … use to …?** (من غير d).
قارن الماضي بالحاضر: used to … ← **now** + present simple.
مرة واحدة أو عدد مرات محدد ← **past simple** مش used to.
**be / get used to + -ing** = متعود / اتعود، وده معنى تاني خالص.
